metadata.description: Claude Code skills for product work rather than code — Figma files and product specs

plugins.name: fig
plugins.description: A bundle for a Figma file several people share. It lays out the sections and stubs the states you're missing so the gaps become your to-draw list, draws each one anchored to your file's own conventions, then wires the flow, audits the file, and syncs the canonical page once engineering ships. prep, draw, arrows, lint, sync, code, qa, deck and more.

plugins.name: pm
plugins.description: A bundle for product docs and the tasks that follow. Write and verify a spec, draft a task's context table from a request thread, file it in the engineering tracker, and reconcile the two sides. Where things are stored is decided by config.
